questions.label: Forest path
questions.prompt: You find a fork in a forest path. Which way do you go?

options.label: Whichever one feels right
Climb a tree to scout both
Wait and watch the path
Pick the bolder-looking one

questions.label: Storm rolls in
questions.prompt: A sudden storm is rolling in. What is your first move?

options.label: Find shelter for everyone nearby
Step out and face the wind
Read the sky and plan the next hour
Stay put and let it pass

questions.label: Quiet presence
questions.prompt: In a noisy room, where do people naturally find you?

options.label: The corner, listening more than talking
The center, holding the conversation
Quietly watching from the edges
Wherever the spark is happening
Step in and translate between them
Give them space and check in later
Name what you see, even if it stings
Quietly leave and let them sort it

questions.label: Crossing the river
questions.prompt: There's a river between you and the goal. You...

options.label: Jump in and swim straight across
Build a small raft or bridge
Walk the bank until you find a ford
Sit and reflect on whether to cross

questions.label: Unexpected gift
questions.prompt: A stranger hands you a sealed box. You...

options.label: Open it on the spot
Inspect it carefully before opening
Thank them and save it for later
Open it together with the nearest person

questions.label: Night walk
questions.prompt: Walking alone at night, what do you notice first?

options.label: The stars and the shape of the sky
The small sounds and what they hint at
The shadows along the path
Your own breathing and thoughts

questions.label: Friend's dilemma
questions.prompt: A close friend asks for honest advice on a big choice. You...

options.label: Tell them what you think they should do
Ask questions until they answer themselves
Share a story that reframes it
Sit with them and hold the space

archetypes.label: Fox
archetypes.tagline: Clever, adaptable, and quick to read any room.
archetypes.blind-spot: Strategy can shade into manipulation when stakes are small.

archetypes.label: Wolf
archetypes.tagline: Loyal, brave, and fiercely protective of the pack.
archetypes.blind-spot: Loyalty can harden into clannishness when the group is wrong.

archetypes.label: Owl
archetypes.tagline: Patient, observant, and wise in the long view.
archetypes.blind-spot: Analysis can stall into hesitation when the moment calls for action.

archetypes.label: Turtle
archetypes.tagline: Steady, enduring, and at home with slow progress.
archetypes.blind-spot: Patience can tip into avoidance when speed would actually help.

archetypes.label: Hawk
archetypes.tagline: Sharp-eyed, focused, and decisive from a height.
archetypes.blind-spot: High-altitude focus can miss the small thing happening right below.

archetypes.label: Bear
archetypes.tagline: Strong, grounded, and quietly confident in body and mind.
archetypes.blind-spot: Self-reliance can become isolation when help would arrive quickly.

archetypes.label: Deer
archetypes.tagline: Gentle, alert, and graceful under pressure.
archetypes.blind-spot: Sensitivity can read threat where there is only good news.

archetypes.label: Dragon
archetypes.tagline: Visionary, bold, and built for the long arc.
archetypes.blind-spot: Big-picture thinking can underweight the boring details that hold it up.
